name: std/base
description: The library that needs no host: strings and their pool, streams and number conversion, dates, bit sets, options, locks, pipes, the plugin registry, and the small collections.
residual: The modules under `graphical` belong to this package but cannot travel in the headless SDK: their own import closure reaches the window system. The list is checked against the import graph by docker/gen-headless-core.sh, so it cannot go quietly out of date.

Members were selected as high-fan-in AND low-fan-out (true foundation). High-fan-in HUBS were deliberately excluded because they also fan out into higher tiers and belong there, not in base: Configuration/Localization (pull XML -> std/web), Codecs (pull Raster -> std/gfx, SoundDevices), Repositories/Models (pull XML + WMEvents -> std/web + std/gui), Types (pull Texts -> std/text).
Candidate additions pending confirmation they stay runtime-only: none outstanding in this batch.

Channels is a parametric module: it is instantiated in an import (Channels(Event)) and therefore must be in the library as a symbol file before anything can instantiate it. A module beside the program cannot be.
